row.team_price_text: Standard: price not public (pricing page blocked)
row.evidence: BrightGauge (now ConnectWise Reports and Dashboards) docs say "ConnectWise Home Admins with access to user management need to invite new users, edit, or delete existing users from Home"; users are added by name and email and disabled by hand, and no SCIM or provisioning API is documented.
row.notes: New row. BrightGauge was renamed ConnectWise Reports and Dashboards and its site redirects to connectwise.com, which served a Cloudflare challenge (403) to curl, the headless renderer and WebFetch, so the public pricing page (connectwise.com/platform/brightgauge/pricing) could not be read; plan names come from the vendor's Plan Comparison and Billing docs, and pricing_page_url points at the Plan Comparison doc. Plans: Analytics Starter (free), Standard, Enterprise, Enterprise+; billed monthly unless prepaid annually; Admin/Analyst seats are licensed, Viewers unlimited. Identity runs through ConnectWise Home / ConnectWise SSO: admins add users by name and email and assign the BrightGauge app role (Admin, Analyst, Viewer); disabling in Home revokes access to all connected ConnectWise apps. ConnectWise Home's Authentication tab doc (readable only inside a docs guest session, so not cited) describes per-user external OIDC login providers such as Entra ID and Okta; no SCIM, JIT or user-management API is documented, and the SSO plan gate is not stated.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint found in the BrightGauge docs or ConnectWise Home docs (site search for 'SCIM' returns only unrelated pages); false by absence.

fallbacks.other_sync: ConnectWise Home acts as the shared identity directory for ConnectWise apps; users and BrightGauge app roles are managed there.

open_questions: Plan prices could not be read: connectwise.com returns a Cloudflare challenge to every non-interactive client.

External IdP (OIDC) sign-in via ConnectWise Home could not be cited: the Home Authentication tab doc only loads inside a docs.connectwise.com guest session, so the quote checker cannot reach it; plan gate also undocumented.
No public BrightGauge or ConnectWise Home user-management API was found.
Whether disabling a user in ConnectWise Home frees a BrightGauge Admin/Analyst licence is not stated.
